payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Jeanene, Layla, Mona, Pauline, Sara, Shaunna

payload.content: Jeanene planning: private costs suggest best feasible options are ISSUE-0001::triage (2.16), ISSUE-0001::review/docs (2.70), ISSUE-0001::test (3.78). ISSUE-0002 tasks are much costlier for me. Tentative preference: ISSUE-0001::triage, else review/docs. Please share your intended claims to avoid duplicates and maximize coverage.

Sara planning: my feasible costs rank as ISSUE-0002::review (9.00) best, then ISSUE-0002::test (12.60), then ISSUE-0001::triage (16.00). ISSUE-0002::implement is 19.00 and ISSUE-0001 review/docs/test/implement are worse. Given objective to maximize tasks completed then priority, I currently lean to claiming ISSUE-0002::review in execution if unclaimed; Jeanene seems better suited to ISSUE-0001::triage. Please share intended claims to avoid duplicates. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Layla planning: my best feasible options by private cost are ISSUE-0001::triage (1.83), ISSUE-0001::review/docs (2.29), ISSUE-0001::test (3.21), ISSUE-0001::implement (4.58). ISSUE-0002 tasks are feasible but expensive for me: review 7.24, test 11.74, implement 18.48. Given objective (maximize tasks completed, then priority, then minimize cost), I tentatively prefer taking an ISSUE-0001 micro-task and leaving ISSUE-0002::review to Sara. Since Jeanene already prefers ISSUE-0001::triage, I can avoid duplication by tentatively targeting ISSUE-0001::test or ISSUE-0001::review/docs, with slight preference for ISSUE-0001::test if others don’t need it. Please share claims so we can cover distinct tasks.

Pauline planning: my private costs strongly favor ISSUE-0001 mobile tasks; ranking is ISSUE-0001::triage (2.25), ISSUE-0001::review/docs (2.82), ISSUE-0001::test (3.94), ISSUE-0001::implement (5.63). ISSUE-0002 tasks are extremely expensive for me (review 40, test 56, implement 80), so I should not take them unless necessary. Given Jeanene already tentatively prefers ISSUE-0001::triage and Sara leans ISSUE-0002::review, I can help maximize distinct feasible coverage by tentatively targeting ISSUE-0001::docs or ISSUE-0001::implement; docs is cheaper for me, implement covers another distinct micro-task if enough agents exist. My current tentative preference is ISSUE-0001::docs, with ISSUE-0001::implement as backup if docs becomes crowded. Please share intended claims for ISSUE-0001 review/test/docs/implement to avoid duplicates. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Mona planning: my private costs are best on ISSUE-0002::review (7.44), then ISSUE-0002::test (10.42), then ISSUE-0002::implement (15.89); ISSUE-0001 tasks are much worse for me (triage 16, review/docs 20, test 28, implement 40). With 7h availability, ISSUE-0002::review (4h) and ISSUE-0002::test (5.6h) are feasible; implement (8h) appears infeasible. Since Sara currently leans ISSUE-0002::review and is costlier there than me, a good distinct-coverage plan may be: I take ISSUE-0002::test, Sara takes ISSUE-0002::review, Jeanene takes ISSUE-0001::triage, Layla takes ISSUE-0001::test or review, Pauline takes ISSUE-0001::docs, leaving someone for ISSUE-0001::implement/review if feasible. Tentative preference for execution: ISSUE-0002::test, with ISSUE-0002::review as backup only if Sara switches. Please avoid assigning me ISSUE-0001 tasks unless needed.

Shaunna planning: my private costs rank ISSUE-0001::triage 1.65, ISSUE-0001::review/docs 2.06, ISSUE-0001::test 2.88, ISSUE-0001::implement 4.12, then ISSUE-0002::review 8.53, ISSUE-0002::test 11.94, ISSUE-0002::implement 17.05. With 10h availability, all except ISSUE-0002::implement are feasible by hours, but 0002 tasks are much costlier. Given current tentative plan from others (Jeanene triage, Sara 0002 review, Mona 0002 test, Pauline docs, Layla test/review), I can help maximize distinct coverage by tentatively targeting ISSUE-0001::implement despite slightly higher cost than review/docs, since it adds another completed distinct task. If Layla takes test and Pauline takes docs, then a clean allocation could be Jeanene triage, Layla review or test, Pauline docs, Shaunna implement, Sara 0002 review, Mona 0002 test. My tentative preference is ISSUE-0001::implement; backup ISSUE-0001::review if someone else is better positioned for implement or if coverage changes. Please coordinate to avoid duplication. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Sara planning update: I support the emerging distinct-coverage plan. My tentative execution claim remains ISSUE-0002::review.
